resources.string: Lumi checks GitHub for a new release when it opens (at most every 12 hours). Nothing runs in the background.
Allow Lumi to install apps, then come back and tap Install.
No connection. Check your internet and try again.
GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again in a while.
GitHub could not be reached or answered with an error. Try again later.
The release information could not be read.
This release has no APK file to download.
The downloaded file is damaged (size or checksum does not match). It was discarded; try again.

This APK is signed with a different key than the installed Lumi, so Android will not install it as an update. Uninstall Lumi first (export a backup in Settings) or install a build signed with the same key.
